subject: Managed listing tier pricing and demo-credit allocation for marketplace co-sell
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@aws-partner.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Managed listing tier + promo credits for Redwood co-sell

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to see the traction you’re getting with a handful of early enterprise customers. Marketplace ops want to fast-track a managed listing and a co-sell promotion tied to a tiered monthly commit so the field can pitch a discounted demo/PO route.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm SKU + SKU family mapping (so we can publish metering). We attached a standard pricing template (aws_pricing_template.xlsx).
- Agree on three listing tiers (Starter / Scale / Enterprise) and the monthly commit thresholds and corresponding market price.
- Allocation of promotional demo credits for partner-led demos (we usually issue a one-time pool per partner: propose $7k in credits to start).
- Co-sell uplift and attribution: what telemetry will you expose so co-sell reps can see usage and convert to renewals?
- Any constraints for providing test accounts to Marketplace Ops for gallery/demos (timeboxed access, data retention rules).

Can you confirm you can get a first-pass pricing spreadsheet back by EOD Wednesday so we can loop Legal/MP-ops and issue a docusign for the managed-listing addendum?

Thanks,
Taylor
Taylor Reed
Partner PM, AWS Marketplace
AWS Partner Network

Attachments: aws_pricing_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Managed listing tier + promo credits for Redwood co-sell

Hi Taylor — really appreciate the clear asks. We’re aligned and can hit the Wednesday turnaround. Quick notes below; attaching our proposed spreadsheet and an initial SKU map.

Summary (top-level):
- We'll map three SKUs: redwood.gen.small (Starter), redwood.gen.medium (Scale), redwood.gen.large (Enterprise). See attached proposed_marketplace_pricing_v1.xlsx.
- Proposed public list price and marketplace price delta: Starter (on-demand $0.0009/token -> MP price $0.0008), Scale (on-demand $0.0007 -> MP price $0.0006), Enterprise (on-demand $0.0005 -> MP price $0.00042).
- Monthly commit thresholds (suggested): Starter < 5M tokens, Scale 5–50M, Enterprise 50M+. We’re open to calibrating based on regional demand.
- Promo/demo credits: Redwood agrees to a one-time $7k credit pool for partner-led demos. We’ll provision as coupon codes tied to MP accounts; ops will need read-only access to redemption telemetry.
- Telemetry for attribution: we can expose a marketplace-specific api_key prefix and a monthly usage report (CSV) tied to the SKU and partner referral ID. Will require MP-ops to accept CSV ingestion or S3 pull.

Ask from our side:
- Legal needs MP-managed addendum (we prefer to avoid passing on any new indemnities; standard managed-listing addendum is fine).
- Ops: need a sandbox tenant for 90 days with smoke data and a dedicated demo org; will need guidance on onboarding automation (Marketplace Ops to provide onboarding playbook).

I’m looping Olga and Vivek so they can confirm commercial/legal guardrails and the telemetry plan.

Next steps:
1) We’ll send back the finalized spreadsheet (attached) by EOD Wednesday.
2) Marketplace to circulate the managed-listing addendum for signature (DocuSign).
3) MP-ops to provision the demo/test org and share onboarding docs.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: proposed_marketplace_pricing_v1.xlsx (pricing spreadsheet)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: quick triage — AcmeCloud managed listing asks

Folks — forwarding Taylor's note. Quick operational checklist so we can turn the spreadsheet into a publishable package: 

1) Legal / Contract: Olga, can Legal accept the managed-listing addendum with the three tiers and a $7k promotional credit? Any clause we should flag (indemnity, data residency, audit rights)?
2) Billing / Finance: Monica, confirm revenue seat: marketplace takes a percentage on MP price; we need to know how to reflect the MarketPlace price in our billing UI and whether we should create a separate "MP metered" SKU in billing. Also confirm whether promotional credits will be applied as a contra-revenue line or as a discount to the partner account.
3) Telemetry / Engineering: Vivek, we will expose a marketplace-specific api_key prefix and monthly usage CSV. Engineering effort: generate a per-partner usage export, store to partner-specific S3, and keep it for 13 months. Estimate: 2 sprint tickets (ingest + retention). Can you triage?

I attached a raw SKU map (sku-mapping.csv) — we'll tidy before sending back. Once Legal signs off, I’ll ask Taylor for the DocuSign link and MP-ops will provision the sandbox org.

Please reply with blockers by EOD so I can keep MP-ops on schedule.

— Markus

Attachments: sku-mapping.csv (draft)

From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@aws-partner.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Managed listing tier + promo credits for Redwood co-sell — next steps

Thanks Markus — this is great and aligns with MP-ops expectations. A few confirmations and next steps: 

- DocuSign: sending managed-listing addendum to your legal contact (Olga) now — track here: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef1234567890
- MP-ops will provision a sandbox tenant (90 days) and will create one demo account per listed SKU. Expect provisioning within 3 business days after the signed addendum.
- We’ll set the promotional credit to $7k as requested. We will publish a demo-coupon code and share redemption telemetry to the S3 bucket you specify.
- Please provide the finalized spreadsheet and the finalized sku-mapping.csv before we publish; publishing window is next Thursday (16 Dec) if we have signatures by EOD Friday.

Looping in MP-ops for provisioning guidance.

Best,
Taylor
Partner PM, AWS Marketplace

Marketplace Ops Note: provisioning playbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood-Marketplace-Docs
